mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing paroxetine plasma concentrations since paroxetine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for increased paroxetine side effects (serotonin syndrome symptoms, CNS effects); dose adjustment may be considered if significant accumulation occurs with prolonged clotrimazole use.
